notes.title: UPDATE 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Dev Glitch Here


So! i updated some things, and changed others!
I am still trying to find everty typo i made until this far, AND, the final cutscene is to be remade! this time should look PRETTY professinal!

other things i need to make it clear: The second route to the game is planned to be BIG, so it will take a while to be ready, but i will still be updating you guys in the GAMEJOLT page! or my twitter!

and the last thing i need to say, is that, if everything goes well, i may be able to update the game to an GAME MAKER style, i have some people that i know, but its not 100% sure it will happen, but i hope it does!

anyway, here the things i changed:

-added a timed attack, everytime you attack, you need to clikc in the right time, in order to deal more damage

-optimizations

-added boss rush mode(i will still be doing some changes into that)

-added a start to the boss rush mode(isnt ready yet)


anyways, much things coming yet, so, stay turned!

hugs!

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 2[/b]

[b]Hello everyone[/b]! Dev Glitch here

So! a time without updates, right? if you didnt saw, we have a GameJolt page, where i post EVERYTHING i update, so, consider checking there in a moment haha

I was doing school things, thats why i didnt updated it anymore, but, now its getting one! A BIG ONE

If you are old enough on this journey, you may see the game has just 1 ending, and in the older version on game jolt, it has a thing called "[i]nightmare route[/i]"
this, is the second ending for broken minds, and to unlock it, you should finish the game first

in this tiny little update i made, i fixed some bugs you guys reported me, AND, added the feature that will be used to unlock the nightmare route!

its now under the "Continue" option in the menu
